entities.summary: Yan Bronislavovich Kaminsky is a Russian former professional ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Championship League and National Hockey League between 1989 and 1995. He played for Dynamo Moscow, Winnipeg Jets, and New York Islanders. He was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1993. He currently resides in Kennesaw, Georgia where he serves as Youth Hockey Director for the Atlanta Madhatters hockey team.
